[[Shadowthread Cave]] {{co|56.7|32.0|Teldrassil}} is in the northwest corner of the [[Shadowglen]] in [[Teldrassil]].  While it has always been home to the great [[spider]]s of Teldrassil, recently the spiders have become increasingly hostile and the cave much more dangerous. The largest spider in the Shadowthread Cave is named [[Githyiss the Vile]], a particularly nasty specimen that has been the bane of more than one inexperienced Kaldorei.
